name: dl
description: Daily learning in Claude Code: Chitas (Chumash with Rashi, Tehillim, Tanya), Rambam, Hayom Yom and Daf Yomi (with Rashi) on one line above the prompt, and the full Hebrew text in a sidebar.

hebrew_font.title: Hebrew font
hebrew_font.description: The font the sidebar's Hebrew is drawn in: Frank Ruhl (the default) or Shlomo, both bundled, with nikkud. The Desktop app draws with it directly; for Ghostty it's installed for your user and Ghostty's Hebrew is mapped to it. System leaves every font alone.

english.title: English
english.description: Show the English translation: Off, Staggered (under each paragraph) or Side by side (English left, Hebrew right).

rashi.title: Rashi
rashi.description: Show Rashi under each verse (Chumash) or passage (Daf Yomi).

text_size.title: Text size
text_size.description: The sidebar's text size in the Desktop app (a terminal uses its own).
